$comment: Screen flow. Quick Start is 2 screens; Custom Game is 1. See docs/05-flow.html for the interactive version.

screens.$note: No Exit (it is a web page). No Credits button (lives in Settings). No Leaderboards until a backend exists.
Random is a first-class tile in the grid, not a menu item.

screens.$icons: Each ammunition row shows the shell icon.

screens.teaches: bracketing, using three real trajectories: short 69, long 82, hit 76
screens.$note: Do NOT add a trajectory preview. See docs/05-flow.html.
Higher priority than TITLE. It decides whether a second match happens.
screens.$icons: Recap shows icons for the shells each player spent.

iconRule: Every surface that names a shell shows its icon alongside the name. Paths are in shells.json under each shell's 'icon' field. Icons are stroke-only and use currentColor, so a single file covers selected, unselected and disabled states.
